Governance, quality standards and review gates

takeaways: Consistent AI movies come from architecture, not better prompts: Copilot plans a parametric shot list, Seedance locks character identity and Higgsfield handles motion.
Keeping motion strength in a moderate range, reusing the exact same reference pack and @ tags, and documenting every configuration prevents character drift and wasted credits.
Governance artifacts such as a production bible, configuration logs, quality criteria and three human review gates make AI video production reproducible and affordable.
hook: AI video creators lose hours and credits when characters change faces between shots. This episode is for creators and teams who want professional, consistent AI films instead of random clips. Learn how to orchestrate Copilot, Seedance and Higgsfield into one governed production pipeline.
